title: The Kingdom Of Adam And The Old World
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2025-12-26

Opens [Titus 1](/bible/titus/1) · [Luke 2](/bible/luke/2) · [Dan 7](/bible/daniel/7) · [2 Pet 1](/bible/2-peter/1) · [1 Cor 2](/bible/1-corinthians/2) · [Eph 4](/bible/ephesians/4) · [Hos 12](/bible/hosea/12) · [Col 1](/bible/colossians/1) · [Gen 1](/bible/genesis/1) · [2 Esdras 9](/bible/2-esdras/9) · [2 Cor 12](/bible/2-corinthians/12) · [Heb 4](/bible/hebrews/4) · [2 Esdras 7](/bible/2-esdras/7) · [Gen 2](/bible/genesis/2) · [Gen 3](/bible/genesis/3) · [Ezek 31](/bible/ezekiel/31) · and 2 more below
## Introduction *[[1:04:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=3881s)]* A marathon class on the kingdom of Adam and the old world before the fall. It opens by setting aside Christmas as a Jewish fable, showing that Christ was born and died at Passover. The teacher then argues that Moses hid the secrets of wisdom in similitudes, so Genesis 1 describes more than the making of the sky and the sea. The first light is Christ, the dividing of light from darkness is the choosing of the children of light, and paradise was made on the second day before the earth. Adam ruled the heavens and the earth with the twelve tribes as his branches, until his fall cast them down to the nether parts of the earth. Ezekiel 31's great cedar, 2 Esdras and the Psalms are read as the record of that fall, and of the kingdom Israel must now work to regain. ## In The News - *[[1:37:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=5829s)]* **An article on Antiochus setting up an idol in the temple, the Maccabean revolt, and the rededication later kept as Hanukkah.** — God has his feast days and Satan has his; Christmas sits where the idol once stood. - *[[2:27:35](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=8855s)]* **A dictionary definition of 'similitude' as a model, parable or comparison.** — God spoke to the prophets in similitudes, so the garden, the trees and the rivers stand for something more. - *[[4:16:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=15419s)]* **A report of a wealthy man offering a fortune to anyone who can prove the earth is flat.** — The Bible says God hangs the earth upon nothing, and the offer mocks those who believe otherwise. - *[[7:47:14](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=28034s)]* **A Bible dictionary entry giving 'descent' as the meaning of the name Jared.** — In Jared's days the sons of God began to descend to the earth, which ties back to Ezekiel 31. ## Scriptures Opened **[Titus 1:14](/bible/titus/1#v14)** *[[1:14:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=4478s)]* > [14](/bible/titus/1#v14) Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth. - Do not give heed to Jewish fables, and Christmas is one of them. - Christ was not born on December 25. Precepts: - **[Song of Solomon 8:5](/bible/song-of-solomon/8#v5)** > [5](/bible/song-of-solomon/8#v5) Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee. Read by the teacher as a prophecy of the birth of Christ. **[Luke 2:6](/bible/luke/2#v6)** *[[1:18:03](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=4683s)]* > [6](/bible/luke/2#v6) And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered. - There was no room in the inn because Jerusalem was full for Passover, one of the three feasts every male attended. - Shepherds were abiding in the fields at night, which fits the spring and not winter. - The wise men were Israelites living east of Jerusalem, and they found the child in a house, not a manger. - Christ went up at twelve for Passover. He was born at Passover and died at Passover. Precepts: - **[Deuteronomy 16:16](/bible/deuteronomy/16#v16)** > [16](/bible/deuteronomy/16#v16) Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the Lord thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the Lord empty: Three times a year all males appear before the Lord: unleavened bread, weeks and tabernacles. - **[Luke 2:8](/bible/luke/2#v8)** > [8](/bible/luke/2#v8) And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. Shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. - **[Matthew 2:1](/bible/matthew/2#v1)** > [1](/bible/matthew/2#v1) Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of Herod the king, behold, there came wise men from the east to Jerusalem, Wise men came from the east, and the star stood over the house where the child was. - **[Luke 2:41](/bible/luke/2#v41)** > [41](/bible/luke/2#v41) Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover. His parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover. **[Daniel 7:25](/bible/daniel/7#v25)** *[[1:38:57](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=5937s)]* > [25](/bible/daniel/7#v25) And he shall speak great words against the most High, and shall wear out the saints of the most High, and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time. - The beast speaks great words against the Most High and thinks to change times and laws. - The lights of heaven set God's times, and the enemy replaced his feasts with new holidays. Precepts: - **[Genesis 1:14](/bible/genesis/1#v14)** > [14](/bible/genesis/1#v14) And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years: The lights are for signs, seasons, days and years. **[2 Peter 1:19](/bible/2-peter/1#v19)** *[[1:48:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=6522s)]* > [19](/bible/2-peter/1#v19) We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts: - There is a more sure word of prophecy, a light in a dark place. - No prophecy is of private interpretation, so every prophet must say the same thing. **[1 Corinthians 2:7](/bible/1-corinthians/2#v7)** *[[1:57:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=7054s)]* > [7](/bible/1-corinthians/2#v7) But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which God ordained before the world unto our glory: - Paul speaks the hidden wisdom of God, ordained before the world. - Eye has not seen what God prepared for those who love him, but the Spirit reveals it. - The natural man cannot receive or know the things of the Spirit. Precepts: - **[1 Corinthians 13:2](/bible/1-corinthians/13#v2)** > [2](/bible/1-corinthians/13#v2) And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing. Paul speaks of understanding all mysteries. - **[Matthew 13:11](/bible/matthew/13#v11)** > [11](/bible/matthew/13#v11) He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given. It is not given to everyone to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven. - **[John 14:15](/bible/john/14#v15)** > [15](/bible/john/14#v15) If ye love me, keep my commandments. If ye love me, keep my commandments, and the Comforter will teach you all things. **[Ephesians 4:11](/bible/ephesians/4#v11)** *[[2:08:33](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=7713s)]* > [11](/bible/ephesians/4#v11) And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; - Apostles, prophets, pastors and teachers are given for the perfecting of the saints. - Prophesying is for edification, exhortation and comfort, so gifts are for the body and not for oneself. Precepts: - **[1 Corinthians 14:1](/bible/1-corinthians/14#v1)** > [1](/bible/1-corinthians/14#v1) Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy. Follow after charity and desire spiritual gifts. - **[Ephesians 3:17](/bible/ephesians/3#v17)** > [17](/bible/ephesians/3#v17) That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love, Rooted and grounded in love, to comprehend with all saints. **[Hosea 12:10](/bible/hosea/12#v10)** *[[2:22:34](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=8554s)]* > [10](/bible/hosea/12#v10) I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets. - God multiplied visions and used similitudes by the ministry of the prophets. - Moses was told many wondrous things on the mount and commanded to publish some and hide some. - The beginning of creation did not start with the earth. Precepts: - **[Wisdom of Solomon 9:15](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/9#v15)** > [15](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/9#v15) For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things. The corruptible body presses down the soul, and hardly do we guess the things on earth. - **[Job 11:6](/bible/job/11#v6)** > [6](/bible/job/11#v6) And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth. That he would show thee the secrets of wisdom. **[Colossians 1:15](/bible/colossians/1#v15)** *[[2:29:17](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=8957s)]* > [15](/bible/colossians/1#v15) Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature: - Christ is the firstborn of every creature, created before the heavens and the earth. - By him were created things visible and invisible, thrones, dominions, principalities and powers. - God reveals his secrets to his servants the prophets. Precepts: - **[Amos 3:7](/bible/amos/3#v7)** > [7](/bible/amos/3#v7) Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets. Surely the Lord will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets. **[Genesis 1:1](/bible/genesis/1#v1)** *[[2:37:09](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=9429s)]* > [1](/bible/genesis/1#v1) In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. - The earth was without form, and the deep is space. - 'Let there be light' is the first thing created, the light that is Christ, before the sun and moon existed. Precepts: - **[2 Esdras 6:38](/bible/2-esdras/6#v38)** > [38](/bible/2-esdras/6#v38) And I said, O Lord, thou spakest from the beginning of the creation, even the first day, and saidst thus; Let heaven and earth be made; and thy word was a perfect work. God spoke from the beginning, and brought a light out of his treasures. - **[John 1:4](/bible/john/1#v4)** > [4](/bible/john/1#v4) In him was life; and the life was the light of men. In him was life, and the life was the light of men. - **[John 8:12](/bible/john/8#v12)** > [12](/bible/john/8#v12) Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life. I am the light of the world. **[Genesis 1:4](/bible/genesis/1#v4)** *[[2:55:12](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=10512s)]* > [4](/bible/genesis/1#v4) And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness. - Dividing light from darkness is God choosing the children of light and hardening the rest, as with Pharaoh. - Evening comes before morning, as Cain, Ishmael and Esau were born before the chosen son. - Satan and evil were created too, and everything is made in pairs. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 5:20](/bible/isaiah/5#v20)** > [20](/bible/isaiah/5#v20) Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter! Woe unto them that put darkness for light and light for darkness. - **[Sirach 16:15](/bible/sirach/16#v15)** > [15](/bible/sirach/16#v15) The Lord hardened Pharaoh, that he should not know him, that his powerful works might be known to the world. The Lord hardened Pharaoh. - **[Ephesians 1:5](/bible/ephesians/1#v5)** > [5](/bible/ephesians/1#v5) Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will, Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ. - **[1 Thessalonians 5:5](/bible/1-thessalonians/5#v5)** > [5](/bible/1-thessalonians/5#v5) Ye are all the children of light, and the children of the day: we are not of the night, nor of darkness. Ye are all the children of light and the children of the day. - **[Sirach 42:24](/bible/sirach/42#v24)** > [24](/bible/sirach/42#v24) All things are double one against another: and he hath made nothing imperfect. All things are double one against another, and he hath made nothing imperfect. **[2 Esdras 9:18](/bible/2-esdras/9#v18)** *[[3:11:58](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=11518s)]* > [18](/bible/2-esdras/9#v18) And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me. - Before the earth was made, none spoke against God, for Israel had its celestial body. - Those not in the Lamb's book of life were not chosen from the foundation of the world. - The angel who spoke to John called himself his fellow servant and his brother. Precepts: - **[Revelation 13:8](/bible/revelation/13#v8)** > [8](/bible/revelation/13#v8) And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world. Whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world. - **[Revelation 22:9](/bible/revelation/22#v9)** > [9](/bible/revelation/22#v9) Then saith he unto me, See thou do it not: for I am thy fellowservant, and of thy brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship God. I am thy fellow servant, and of thy brethren the prophets. - **[2 Corinthians 5:1](/bible/2-corinthians/5#v1)** > [1](/bible/2-corinthians/5#v1) For we know that if our earthly house of this tabernacle were dissolved, we have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens. We have a building of God, an house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens. **[2 Corinthians 12:2](/bible/2-corinthians/12#v2)** *[[3:41:45](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=13305s)]* > [2](/bible/2-corinthians/12#v2) I knew a man in Christ above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;) such an one caught up to the third heaven. - Paul was caught up to the third heaven, which is paradise. - The heavens are built in stories, like the three stories of the temple and the ark. Precepts: - **[Wisdom of Solomon 9:7](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/9#v7)** > [7](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/9#v7) Thou hast chosen me to be a king of thy people, and a judge of thy sons and daughters: Wisdom was present when God made the world. - **[Ezekiel 41:16](/bible/ezekiel/41#v16)** > [16](/bible/ezekiel/41#v16) The door posts, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about on their three stories, over against the door, cieled with wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows, and the windows were covered; The galleries of the temple round about on their three stories. - **[Genesis 6:16](/bible/genesis/6#v16)** > [16](/bible/genesis/6#v16) A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; with lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make it. The ark had lower, second and third stories. - **[Amos 9:6](/bible/amos/9#v6)** > [6](/bible/amos/9#v6) It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven, and hath founded his troop in the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: The Lord is his name. It is he that buildeth his stories in the heaven. **[Genesis 1:6](/bible/genesis/1#v6)** *[[3:53:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=14018s)]* > [6](/bible/genesis/1#v6) And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters. - The firmament divides the waters beneath from the waters above, and God called it heaven. - Paradise was made on the second day, before the earth appeared on the third. - Time on earth began with the sun and moon on the fourth day, but with God a day is as a thousand years. Precepts: - **[2 Esdras 3:6](/bible/2-esdras/3#v6)** > [6](/bible/2-esdras/3#v6) And thou leadest him into paradise, which thy right hand had planted, before ever the earth came forward. Paradise, which thy right hand had planted before ever the earth came forward. - **[2 Peter 3:8](/bible/2-peter/3#v8)** > [8](/bible/2-peter/3#v8) But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day. One day is with the Lord as a thousand years. - **[Isaiah 57:15](/bible/isaiah/57#v15)** > [15](/bible/isaiah/57#v15) For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones. The high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity. - **[Job 26:7](/bible/job/26#v7)** > [7](/bible/job/26#v7) He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing. He hangeth the earth upon nothing. **[Genesis 1:26](/bible/genesis/1#v26)** *[[4:31:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=16301s)]* > [26](/bible/genesis/1#v26) And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. - Man was made in God's image, not only in looks but like his father in nature. - 'Replenish' means to fill again, and Adam was told to subdue the earth. Precepts: - **[Genesis 2:7](/bible/genesis/2#v7)** > [7](/bible/genesis/2#v7) And the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul. God breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living soul. - **[Wisdom of Solomon 2:23](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/2#v23)** > [23](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/2#v23) For God created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity. God created man to be immortal and made him an image of his own eternity. **[Hebrews 4:1](/bible/hebrews/4#v1)** *[[4:45:48](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=17148s)]* > [1](/bible/hebrews/4#v1) Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it. - God did not rest because he was tired. Entering his rest means entering paradise. - Those who believe enter into rest, and those who did not believe were kept out. Precepts: - **[Matthew 6:10](/bible/matthew/6#v10)** > [10](/bible/matthew/6#v10) Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done in earth as it is in heaven. - **[Deuteronomy 11:21](/bible/deuteronomy/11#v21)** > [21](/bible/deuteronomy/11#v21) That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the Lord sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth. As the days of heaven upon the earth. - **[Revelation 21:2](/bible/revelation/21#v2)** > [2](/bible/revelation/21#v2) And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband. The holy city coming down from God out of heaven. **[2 Esdras 7:6](/bible/2-esdras/7#v6)** *[[6:01:38](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=21698s)]* > [6](/bible/2-esdras/7#v6) There is also another thing; A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things: - The city of the inheritance has a narrow entrance between fire and deep water. - The entrances of the elder world were wide and sure and brought immortal fruit. - After Adam transgressed, the ways became narrow, and Israel must now labour for the inheritance. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 1:26](/bible/isaiah/1#v26)** > [26](/bible/isaiah/1#v26) And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city. I will restore thy judges as at the first. - **[Sirach 36:10](/bible/sirach/36#v10)** > [10](/bible/sirach/36#v10) Smite in sunder the heads of the rulers of the heathen, that say, There is none other but we. Smite the heads of the rulers of the heathen, and gather all the tribes of Jacob together. - **[Wisdom of Solomon 1:13](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/1#v13)** > [13](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/1#v13) For God made not death: neither hath he pleasure in the destruction of the living. God made not death, and the generations of the world were healthful. **[Genesis 2:8](/bible/genesis/2#v8)** *[[6:19:22](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=22762s)]* > [8](/bible/genesis/2#v8) And the Lord God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed. - The trees of the garden are the trees of righteousness, Israel in their heavenly bodies. - The tree of life stood in the midst of the garden. Precepts: - **[Isaiah 61:3](/bible/isaiah/61#v3)** > [3](/bible/isaiah/61#v3) To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified. That they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord. - **[Psalms 1:3](/bible/psalms/1#v3)** > [3](/bible/psalms/1#v3) And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper. Like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season. **[Genesis 2:10](/bible/genesis/2#v10)** *[[6:24:36](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=23076s)]* > [10](/bible/genesis/2#v10) And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads. - The river out of Eden that parted into four heads is the wisdom and law that flow from God. - Sirach names the same rivers as the flow of understanding, and the sea of glass is that clear water in heaven. Precepts: - **[Sirach 24:25](/bible/sirach/24#v25)** > [25](/bible/sirach/24#v25) He filleth all things with his wisdom, as Phison and as Tigris in the time of the new fruits. He filleth all things with his wisdom, as Phison and as Tigris in the time of the new fruits. - **[Revelation 22:1](/bible/revelation/22#v1)** > [1](/bible/revelation/22#v1) And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb. A pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne. - **[Sirach 19:19](/bible/sirach/19#v19)** > [19](/bible/sirach/19#v19) The knowledge of the commandments of the Lord is the doctrine of life: and they that do things that please him shall receive the fruit of the tree of immortality. The knowledge of the commandments of the Lord is the doctrine of life. - **[Numbers 24:5](/bible/numbers/24#v5)** > [5](/bible/numbers/24#v5) How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel! How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, as trees which the Lord hath planted. - **[Zechariah 14:8](/bible/zechariah/14#v8)** > [8](/bible/zechariah/14#v8) And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be. Adam knew Eve his wife, and she bare Cain. ## Class Questions - **Why was there no room in the inn when Christ was born?** Jerusalem was full for Passover, one of the three feasts every male attended (Deuteronomy 16:16). - **What is the light of Genesis 1:3?** The first thing God created, Christ, before the sun and moon were made (John 1:4; Colossians 1:15). - **When was paradise made?** On the second day, before the earth came forward (2 Esdras 3:6). - **What did the trees of the garden stand for?** The trees of righteousness, Israel, the planting of the Lord (Isaiah 61:3). - **How does 2 Esdras 7 describe the old world?** Its entrances were wide and sure and brought immortal fruit, until Adam's transgression made them narrow. - **What does Ezekiel 31 say happened to the cedar's boughs?** They were delivered to death in the nether parts of the earth, and the nations shook at his fall. ## In Closing *[[8:08:06](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SE81_Rxu5sM&t=29286s)]* Adam ruled the heavens and the earth, and his fall cast Israel down to the nether parts.
